Occasion-Level Calculation: Mean of Two Integer Ratings From 0 to 4
Main Technical Criteria: Both ratings must be valid and scorable. Code 0 when smiling is absent and missing when unscorable. Code each 640 × 480, silent 2-fps video as a whole.

Occasion-Level Calculation: AU-Positive Frames Divided by Valid Face Frames
Main Technical Criteria: OpenFace 2.2.0 static classifier; success = 1 and confidence ≥ .80; ≥80% occasion coverage; original 15-fps frames.

Occasion-Level Calculation: Convert to semitones, then calculate the median and Q75 − Q25 across valid frames for the occasion.
Main Technical Criteria: SHS/Viterbi, 55–1000 Hz, internal cutoff = .7, RMS ≥ .001, 60-ms window and 10-ms step. Apply no additional three-point smoothing. Require ≥100 frames for the median and ≥200 for IQR, with ≥80% candidate-cycle support coverage.

Occasion-Level Calculation: Mean of eligible frame autocorrelation outputs in dB.
Main Technical Criteria: Same target-time criteria as F0; ≥100 frames and ≥80% candidate-cycle support coverage. Retain genuine zero or negative dB values.

Occasion-Level Calculation: Duration of complete candidate pauses ≥200 ms divided by D_s.
Main Technical Criteria: Require Q99(dBFS) − 25 dB and Silero VAD p < .5 per occasion. Retain short events in the denominator, with no 2-s cap. Require D_s ≥ 1 s and ≥80% T_ref coverage.

Occasion-Level Calculation: Algorithm-detected periodic voicing time divided by D_v.
Main Technical Criteria: Use the final SHS/Viterbi state and specified RMS gate. Periodic laughter by the target is eligible. D_v includes silence and normal unvoiced segments. Require D_v ≥ 1 s and ≥80% T_ref coverage.

Occasion-Level Calculation: Time-weighted mean of valid local ratios × 100.
Main Technical Criteria: Require ≥100 estimates with current-cycle and adjacent-cycle-pair support and ≥1 s of output support. Exclude placeholders, carried-forward values, and gap contamination regardless of magnitude.

Occasion-Level Calculation: Median ROI temperature per frame, averaged across eligible frames in the occasion.
Main Technical Criteria: Sample 30 frames; require ≥23 for the nasal tip and ≥22 per cheek. No imputation or left/right relabeling.
Automatic correction with NeuroKit2 0.2.13. Use the full response and C_RR ≤ 10%. Minimum durations 10, 30, and 60 s. No beat-by-beat ECG validation.

Occasion-Level Calculation: Extract SBP and DBP separately for each occasion.
Main Technical Criteria: Match investigator-confirmed values using the existing name–ID table. Require SBP > DBP > 0. Both outcomes were complete in the primary 100 and the subset of 92.
